name: K G Denim Limited
about: K G Denim Limited manufactures and sells denim and apparel fabrics worldwide. It operates through Textile, Power, and Garment segments. The company offers home textile products, readymade garments, and apparel products. It operates a power plant. It offers its products through online platform. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Coimbatore, India.
